title: "Category Collapsing for Low-Frequency Likert Items"

  html_document:
    toc: true
    theme: readable
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = TRUE
)

library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(here)

# Paths are relative to the repository root (instrument.Rproj)
phase_dir  <- here("phase3-validation")
data_dir   <- file.path(phase_dir, "data", "prepared")
output_dir <- file.path(phase_dir, "00_collapse-categories", "output")
```

## 1. Defining Function

```{r define-function}
collapse_logic <- function(file_name, threshold = 0.025, out_dir = output_dir) {
  
  if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  base_file   <- basename(file_name)
  output_name <- gsub(".csv", "_lowfreqcollapsed.csv", base_file)
  output_path <- file.path(out_dir, output_name)
  
  log_name    <- gsub(".csv", "_changes_made.csv", base_file)
  log_path    <- file.path(out_dir, log_name)
  
  if (!file.exists(file_name)) {
    message("--- File not found: ", file_name)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df_mod <- read.csv(file_name, check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
  message("--- Processing: ", file_name)
  
  # Ignore id and non-item columns
  items <- setdiff(names(df_mod), c("id", "seed", "stimulus"))
  
  fusion_log <- data.frame(
    item         = character(),
    from         = numeric(),
    to           = numeric(),
    prop         = numeric(),
    num_cases    = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  changes_made <- 0
  
  for (item in items) {
    if (item == "id" || !is.numeric(df_mod[[item]])) next
    
    repeat {
      counts <- table(df_mod[[item]], useNA = "no")
      if (length(counts) <= 1) break 
      
      props <- prop.table(counts)
      low_freq_cats <- as.numeric(names(props[props <= threshold]))
      if (length(low_freq_cats) == 0) break
      
      # Scale with active categories
      active_scale <- sort(as.numeric(names(counts)))
      
      target <- low_freq_cats[1]
      current_idx <- which(active_scale == target)
      
      left_val  <- if (current_idx > 1) active_scale[current_idx - 1] else NA
      right_val <- if (current_idx < length(active_scale)) active_scale[current_idx + 1] else NA
      
      c_left  <- if (!is.na(left_val)) counts[as.character(left_val)] else -1
      c_right <- if (!is.na(right_val)) counts[as.character(right_val)] else -1
      
      # Criteria for selecting the best neighbor
      if (!is.na(left_val) && !is.na(right_val)) {
        destination <- if (c_left >= c_right) left_val else right_val
      } else if (!is.na(left_val)) {
        destination <- left_val
      } else if (!is.na(right_val)) {
        destination <- right_val
      } else {
        break
      }
      
      # Registering change
      n_casos_target <- as.numeric(counts[as.character(target)])
      prop_target    <- as.numeric(props[as.character(target)])
      
      fusion_log <- rbind(
        fusion_log,
        data.frame(
          item      = item,
          from      = target,
          to        = destination,
          prop      = round(prop_target, 4),
          num_cases = n_casos_target,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      )
      
      # Substituting value
      df_mod[[item]][df_mod[[item]] == target] <- destination
      changes_made <- changes_made + 1
    }
  }
  
  write.csv(df_mod, output_path, row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(fusion_log, log_path, row.names = FALSE)
  message("DONE: Saved in ", output_path, " (Total changes: ", changes_made, ")")
  
  return(list(log = fusion_log, changes = changes_made))
}
```

## 2. Execution

```{r run-collapse}
threshold_val <- 0.025

files_to_process <- c(file.path(data_dir, "ux_ratings.csv"))

results_list <- list()

for (f in files_to_process) {
  results_list[[f]] <- collapse_logic(f, threshold = threshold_val, out_dir = output_dir)
}
```

## 3. Summary of Collapsed Categories

```{r show-log, echo=FALSE}
all_logs <- bind_rows(lapply(results_list, function(res) res$log))

if (!is.null(all_logs) && nrow(all_logs) > 0) {
  kable(
    all_logs,
    caption = "Merged Categories (Proportion <= 2.5%)",
    col.names = c("Item", "Original Value", "Merged Into", "Proportion", "Cases (N)")
  )
} else {
  cat("**No categories required collapsing or the input file was not found.**")
}
```

## 4. Files for the next steps

The collapsed UXVis items are combined with the gold-standard answers, which are not collapsed. This file is used by step 03.

```{r combine-gold-standards}
ux_collapsed <- read.csv(file.path(output_dir, "ux_ratings_lowfreqcollapsed.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
ueqs <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "ueqs_ratings.csv"), check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
sus  <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "sus_ratings.csv"),  check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")

# The three files have the same participants in the same order
stopifnot(identical(ux_collapsed$id, ueqs$id), identical(ux_collapsed$id, sus$id))

ux_sus_ueqs <- cbind(ux_collapsed,
                     ueqs[, grep("^UEQ_", names(ueqs))],
                     sus[,  grep("^SUS_", names(sus))])

write.csv(ux_sus_ueqs, file.path(output_dir, "uxColaps_sus_ueqs_ratings.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
dim(ux_sus_ueqs)
```

The item codes are replaced by their short names from the codebook. This file is used by steps 05 and 06.

```{r rename-items}
codebook <- read.csv(file.path(phase_dir, "data", "codebook", "items.csv"))

multigroup <- ux_collapsed
item_cols  <- match(codebook$code, names(multigroup))
stopifnot(!anyNA(item_cols))
names(multigroup)[item_cols] <- codebook$short_name

write.csv(multigroup, file.path(output_dir, "multigroup_ratings.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
kable(codebook[, c("code", "short_name", "factor")], caption = "Item names used in multigroup_ratings.csv")
```
